notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷面板命令菜单新增「粘贴 OCR 文字」：对带文字的图片，可直接把识别出的文字粘进当前 App；即使关闭了图片 OCR 开关，点击时也会即时识别再粘贴
- **优化** 设置窗口改为侧边栏导航（参考 macOS 系统设置），分类更清晰，内容不再因过多而被截断
- **优化** 命令菜单按功能分组，更易扫读
- **优化** 首次引导的「隐私保护」步骤现在会标明每个 App 的忽略状态（已忽略 / 未忽略），并加了一行说明，不再让人困惑勾选到底代表忽略还是监控（#63，感谢 @KanTakahiro 的反馈）
- **修复** 命令菜单里粘贴后偶尔「先粘上内容、面板才消失」的滞留感
- **修复** 不带 https:// 的裸域名链接（如 jp.evoxt.lifedever.com）现在能正确打开，并显示站点标题与图标
notes_en:
- **New** "Paste OCR Text" in the quick-panel command menu: paste the recognized text from an image straight into the current app — works even with image OCR turned off (it recognizes on demand)
- **Improve** Settings window redesigned with a sidebar (like macOS System Settings) — clearer grouping, no more clipped content
- **Improve** Command menu is now grouped by function for easier scanning
- **Improve** The Privacy Protection step in onboarding now labels each app's ignore state (Ignored / Not ignored) and shows a one-line hint, so it's clear what the checkmark means (#63, thanks @KanTakahiro for the report)
- **Fix** Removed the lag where the panel lingered after pasting from the command menu
- **Fix** Bare-domain links without https:// (e.g. jp.evoxt.lifedever.com) now open correctly and show their title/favicon
